blind.description: A low, circular stone basin or shallow fountain basin. It features a raised outer stone rim punctuated symmetrically by four raised decorative keystones or blocks, each carved with a scalloped shell motif. The basin floor is paved with concentric rings of wedge-shaped stone slabs radiating from a small central spherical stone dome or boss. The material is weathered yellowish-tan sandstone or limestone with subtle mossy/lichen texture. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no holes, spikes, floating elements, or melted regions. It rests flat directly on the ground without an added plinth.
blind.from_above: A circular stone structure consisting of an outer circular border with four equidistant decorative rectangular blocks, enclosing a recessed floor divided into radiating segmental paving stones surrounding a small raised hemisphere in the exact center.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/6 to 1/5 the height of the figure (about 1 to 1.2 feet tall), and about as wide across as the figure is tall (approx. 5 to 5.5 feet in diameter).
